common.noChangesAndErrors: No changes made and validation errors present

service.label: Service Name
service.description: If kept empty, the service name will be set to "bifrost"

protocol.label: Protocol
protocol.description: Transport used for both trace and metrics export.

headers.commonDescription: Sent to both the trace and metrics endpoints.
headers.traceDescription: Sent only to the trace endpoint, in addition to the common headers.
headers.metricsDescription: Sent only to the metrics endpoint, in addition to the common headers (e.g. a Databricks table name).

tls.insecureDescription: Skip TLS verification. Disable this to use TLS with system root CAs or a custom CA certificate.
tls.caCertDescription: File path to the CA certificate on the Bifrost server. Leave empty to use system root CAs.

traceExport.title: Enable Trace Export
traceExport.description: Export spans to the OTLP collector. Turn off for a metrics-only profile.
traceExport.exportTimeoutDescription: Maximum time for a single trace export (1-60 seconds). Traces are dropped rather than retried past this limit, so an unreachable collector cannot slow down request handling.
traceExport.requestHeadersDescription: Comma-separated list of request headers to capture and emit as span attributes. Supports exact names and wildcard patterns (e.g. <1>x-custom-*</1> captures all headers with that prefix, <3>*</3> captures all headers; note that <5>*</5> will capture sensitive headers like Authorization).
traceExport.disableContentLoggingDescription: When enabled, message content (input/output messages, tool definitions, and tool call arguments/results) is dropped from exported spans. Only metadata such as model, tokens, and latency is sent to the collector.
traceExport.groupBySessionDescription: When enabled, requests sharing the same x-bf-session-id header are grouped into a single trace, each request appearing as a top-level sibling span. A request carrying an inbound W3C traceparent stays on its own distributed trace and is unaffected.
traceExport.disableRootSpanContentDescription: When enabled, input/output message content is dropped from the root span only; the underlying generation (llm.call) span keeps the full content.

metricsExport.title: Enable Metrics Export
metricsExport.description: Push metrics to an OTEL Collector for proper aggregation in cluster deployments
metricsExport.pushIntervalDescription: How often to push metrics (1-300 seconds)

pull.title: Pull-based Scraping
pull.description: Prometheus can scrape metrics from the /metrics endpoint
pull.scrapeHint: Configure your Prometheus server to scrape this endpoint. Served only while Pull-based scraping is enabled.

push.title: Push-based (Push Gateway)
push.description: Push metrics to a Prometheus Push Gateway for proper aggregation in cluster deployments
push.multiNodeWarning: If you are running multiple Bifrost nodes, use push gateway for accurate metrics. Pull-based /metrics scraping may miss nodes behind a load balancer.
push.gatewayUrlDescription: URL of your Prometheus Push Gateway
push.instanceIdTooltip: Used to identify this Bifrost instance in metrics. If not set, hostname is used automatically.

tooltips.noChangesInTab: No changes made in this tab
tooltips.fixOtherTab: Fix validation errors in the {{tab}} tab before saving

view.repoIdHint: You can send in header <1>x-bf-log-repo-id</1> with a repository ID to log to a specific repository.

form.requestHeadersDescription: Comma-separated list of request headers to capture and attach as trace tags. Supports exact names and wildcard patterns (e.g. <1>x-custom-*</1> captures all headers with that prefix, <3>*</3> captures all headers; note that <5>*</5> will capture sensitive headers like Authorization).

toast.stillLoading: Plugin list is still loading. Please wait before saving.
toast.notConfigured: {{destination}} is not configured yet. Save its configuration before configuring plugin tracing.

tracing.title: Configure Plugin Tracing
tracing.description: Choose which plugin hook spans are exported to {{destination}}. Disabling a plugin removes its spans from traces without affecting execution.
tracing.configPrecedence: If <1>plugin_span_filter</1> is set in the <3>{{pluginName}}</3> plugin config in config.json, it takes precedence over these settings after restarting Bifrost.
